_note: Fires and fountains that move in the story worlds (src/vfx/fire_anim.gd, built from the loaded sprites of every graphics set). frames = pictures per loop, fps = loop speed (each fire starts at its own point, so they do not flicker in step). fire: names = the sprites whose flames flicker; a flame pixel is bright (lum) and coloured (sat), or a near-white core (core_lum) next to one, so stone, wood and snow stay still; band = brightness swing of the light bands rising through the flame, band_k = bands per px of height, tip = share of the flame's top edge pixels that fade in and out (the flame licks), tip_rows = how deep that edge reaches (px). water: names = the sprites whose water flows; a water pixel is blue (blue over red by blue_over, at least blue_min) and coloured (sat); band and band_k as for fire, the bands run down, sparkle = share of bright glints.

fire._motion_note: The flame's shape moves too (user 2026-11-01; src/vfx/fire_anim.gd flame_regions, _move_flames), in whole art pixels of the sprite's own grid: flame-mask pixels within gap art px form a group; a flame is a group of at least min_pixels art px and flame_share of the largest group, starting in the upper top_share of the sprite's drawn part and within near_share of the largest group's height below its top (a glowing rune or eyes lower down only get the light), and not slimmer than slim_share of its height (a candle with its wax only gets the light). It takes its whole painted body (connected pixels of its own hue within body_hue, at least body_sat saturated and body_val bright, and faint anti-aliased edges), pale cores it encloses (core_lum) and whole art cells; small patches just above it within spark_reach of its height are its sparks. Its lowest static_share of art rows stays still (it sits in its bowl). Only pixels near the air can open (no hole inside the sprite); the moved flame never covers the stone around it. stretch / stretch2: it grows and shrinks by this share (two waves, the second twice as fast). sway: its tip swings sideways by this share of its width (at least sway_min art px), less toward the base, neighbouring rows by one art px at most; curl: how much that sway bends over the flame's height (radians; the bend rises up the flame).
